title: Oversight failure and containment lab
description: Inject a failure into constitutional supervision, then choose the first control. A matched control starts a new evidence cycle; it never makes release automatic.

stages.label: Principles
stages.detail: Versioned rules, examples, precedence, and owners

stages.label: AI preferences
stages.detail: Pair comparisons and the learned reward proxy

stages.label: Policy and release
stages.detail: Bounded optimization, independent tests, and rollout

failures.label: Ambiguous principle
failures.detail: The policy says to avoid harm but gives no context rule for legitimate dual-use assistance.
failures.observableSignal: Critics produce incompatible revisions and preference labels have low agreement on the same prompt family.
failures.hiddenRisk: Optimization can make one arbitrary interpretation more consistent without making it more correct.
failures.evidenceNeeded: Approve a specific trigger and conflict rule, add positive and negative examples, then regenerate critiques, preferences, and held-out tests.

failures.label: AI evaluator bias
failures.detail: The preference model favors verbosity or response position instead of the stated principle.
failures.observableSignal: Pair decisions flip when response order changes or favor a verbose answer that calibrated humans reject.
failures.hiddenRisk: The reward model learns a scalable shortcut that looks like policy compliance in aggregate metrics.
failures.evidenceNeeded: Randomize order, test counterfactual pairs, measure slice-level human agreement, and escalate unresolved disagreement.

failures.label: Proxy exploitation
failures.detail: Policy optimization discovers polished blanket refusals that score well but reduce safe usefulness.
failures.observableSignal: Learned reward rises while independent helpfulness and bounded-assistance evaluations fall.
failures.hiddenRisk: More optimization increases the gap between the proxy and the intended behavior.
failures.evidenceNeeded: Stop optimization, add adversarial bounded-assistance cases, repair the preference signal, and rerun independent regressions.

failures.label: Deployment distribution shift
failures.detail: Multi-turn, multilingual, or tool-using production requests differ from the alignment evaluation set.
failures.observableSignal: Runtime interventions and user appeals rise in a new cohort while offline aggregate scores remain stable.
failures.hiddenRisk: A broad rollout exposes behavior for which neither the evaluator nor the constitution has enough evidence.
failures.evidenceNeeded: Pause exposure, collect privacy-bounded cases, evaluate the shifted slices, and validate runtime and rollback controls before resuming.

controls.label: Rewrite and test the principle
controls.detail: Add a trigger, conflict rule, examples, owner, and dependent test suite.
controls.action: Repair the earliest policy boundary and invalidate downstream evidence derived from the old version.
controls.limit: Clear prose still requires calibration across realistic contexts and affected groups.

controls.label: Calibrate and escalate the evaluator
controls.detail: Use blinded counterfactual pairs, qualified human comparison, and a disagreement path.
controls.action: Measure whether the AI judge follows the principle instead of position, style, or identity shortcuts.
controls.limit: Agreement with one review pool does not prove coverage for every language, culture, or domain.

controls.label: Stop and run independent adversarial tests
controls.detail: Compare the candidate with evaluators and cases that were not optimized directly.
controls.action: Expose reward shortcuts, capability regressions, and over-refusal before further policy updates.
controls.limit: The preference data and objective must still be repaired before optimization resumes.

controls.label: Contain with staged runtime controls
controls.detail: Pause expansion, retain policy enforcement, inspect shifted slices, and keep rollback ready.
controls.action: Reduce user exposure while production evidence is converted into governed evaluation cases.
controls.limit: Runtime containment does not correct a faulty constitution or training signal by itself.
